justification: Both are low-relief narrative friezes with profile human figures and profile animals moving in a common direction, with figures overlapped in layered registers and details such as fleece, hair and musculature rendered by fine incised patterning over modelled forms — a shared relief convention. The specific subjects differ: A shows a close-up file of horned rams led by attendants in an orderly procession, while B is a crowded battle/hunt scene with chariots, wheels, water swirls, falling and kneeling figures, so no single distinctive motif recurs in the same relationship.
